entries.title: Audit script missing from checkout
entries.root_cause: The audit target invokes scripts/inspect-sluice.sh, which is absent from the checkout. Restore the script at that path or update the target to its actual location.

entries.title: Audit rules file missing
entries.root_cause: The audit script exists but cannot read config/tarn-rules.tsv. Restore the rules file or point the script to its actual location.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The missing file is the rules input opened by the script, not the script invoked by make.

entries.title: Audit script missing from checkout
entries.root_cause: The audit target invokes scripts/inspect-sluice.sh, which is absent from the checkout. Restore the script at that path or update the target to its actual location.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later run uses a different runner, checkout and make wrapper, but invokes the same absent script.

entries.title: Duplicate sluice identifier
entries.root_cause: The sluice manifest contains a duplicate identifier rejected by the audit. Correct or remove the duplicate record.
